title: The goals in the Work queue: ten parent tasks with their owners, and every open item since Nov 25 under its goal
why: CLAUDE.md #1552 (Jason, 2026-11-27: goals and records live with the roles, by Monday 06:00 MST) and #1553 (launch first). For the PM (8), built as Build & QA (21). Sources: decisions/0181 and its notes, 0180's appendix, 0135's and 0164's notes of 2026-11-27, research/launch-plan-jan1-2026-11-26.md §4, §7 (Brief D) and §10, handoffs/decided-not-live.md.

changes.what: Each task can carry a due date and a measure (two new fields, filled on the goals), for the daily goal check

Ten goals as parent tasks (records with the roles, the six launch gates, the Jan 1 launch, the pilot's ladder, the transition cutover), each with its owner from 0180's appendix, its measure, its due date and its decisions

61 open items as their children (notify-founder's own link under gate 4, IT Manager (11)); task #22 Work queue phase 2 updated in place: today's rulings, the PM (8), its decisions, under the transition goal, each citing its source; Brief D's 13 calls as Founder rulings (Tier 5); 14 existing tasks placed under their goals

data_reason: Adds two columns to control_gauge_tasks (due_on DATE NULL, measure VARCHAR(255) NULL; guarded, safe to run twice) and writes them on the 10 goals only where empty. Adds 10 goal tasks and 61 child tasks, their decisions to control_gauge_task_adrs and 13 briefs to control_gauge_task_briefs, each only where it isn't there yet and each with its id named (MAX(id)+1, the staging catch-up rule); sets parent_id on 14 existing tasks only where it is empty. On task #22 (Work queue phase 2) replaces why and done_when only where they are still the 2026-11-24 seed's own text or empty, and owner only where empty: a person's text is never overwritten. Nothing is deleted.
